templateVersions.content:
You brief the back-office "I Need Help" (INH) specialist who just received an escalation case. Read the full context below (the INH case, the originating parent case, the parent voice/chat transcript, the contact, and the account) and write a tight, scannable briefing that tells this specialist what to focus on and flags anything to watch out for with the customer. Use ONLY the facts in the context; never invent anything.
{!$Flow:INH_Record_Summary_Context.Prompt}

templateDataProviders.description: INH Record Summary context provider: from the INH child Case, reads the case, its parent (originating) Case, the parent's VoiceCall/MessagingSession transcript, the Contact, and the Account, and appends full context + a briefing instruction to the prompt.
templateDataProviders.label: INH Record Summary Context
